bottomBarDetails.extraLivesActive_other: +{{count}} additional starting lives added at the start of every run. More lives means more chances to recover from a bad cut.

bottomBarDetails.microManagerActive_other: Each locked ball reduces ball speed by {{percent}}% (stacks multiplicatively, down to a 50% floor). Right now {{count}} balls locked → effective speed {{speed}}.

bottomBarDetails.shipEarlyCountdownDesc: A countdown bar sits above this panel while you play. Clear the map before it drains to earn up to +{{percent}}% of the map's overtime as a Ship Early bonus, paid on TOP of the usual cap: the sooner you finish, the more it pays. The payout drops at each white tick on the bar. Its windows scale with the number of balls on the map, and only active play counts - pauses, menus and the push prompt don't spend the clock.

bottomBarDetails.shipEarlyMultiplierActive: Ship Early bonuses pay x{{mult}} on this map (Hard Deadline).

certificateStore.title: CERTIFICATES
certificateStore.tutorialBody: Spend Certificate Hours (earned as you play) on permanent bonuses, unlocked by mastering upgrade families across runs.
certificateStore.subtitle: Permanent bonuses. Once bought, they apply to every run from now on.
certificateStore.walletNote: A separate wallet from the hours you spend in the upgrade shop

game.moverTutorialBody: Orange obstacles slide along a track. Balls bounce off them, but if your fence touches one you lose a life. Time your cuts.
game.breakTutorialBody: Amber blocks shatter for bonus points, guide balls into them (the black ball is faster). You can't fence against them.
game.circuitTutorialBody: Draw a fence past a teal node to wake its sleeping ball. Sleepers hold their space shut until woken, then you trap them. Wake one at a time.
game.chargeTutorialBody: Draw a fence past a fuse to arm it. It blasts its slab away and opens space, but also frees nearby balls and breaks your fences in range.
game.streamTutorialBody: Draw a fence ALONG the violet seam, not across it, to harvest bonus overtime. More coverage pays more, but tracing it loosens your trap.
game.creepTutorialBody: The balls speed up the longer you take, up to a cap. Finish inside the calm window and you never see it. The red top-bar gauge shows the surge.
game.pickupTutorialBody: Trap a ball in a pocket that also covers a power-up to grab its boost. Let it fade first and it's gone.
game.gravityWellTutorialBody:
A gravity well bends any ball that enters it toward the arrow, then lets go the moment the ball leaves. Speed never changes, so a ball can pass through one and come out somewhere completely new depending on where and how fast it went in.

It is a tool as much as a hazard. Aim a ball into a well to bend it toward a pocket you have already fenced.

A frozen ball ignores gravity entirely, so freezing is a way to hold a ball still inside a well instead of watching it get dragged out.

Some wells start dormant, drawn but inert, and switch on once you have cleared enough of the board.
game.topBarTutorialBody: Your level, lives and objectives sit up top. Tap it, or Specs, for your full run sheet.
game.bottomBarTutorialBody: Tap Specs any time for every stat that shapes your run, explained plainly.
game.timeLimitTutorialBody: Every map now has a time limit. Clear it before the bar empties or the run ends, lives won't save you. Finish early for bonus overtime.

lockInfo.title: Superior Lock
lockInfo.normalBody: Seal a ball into its own pocket, cut off from the board. It pays its lock value; tougher balls pay more.
lockInfo.superiorBody: Seal a ball into an extra-tight pocket, well under half the usual size. It pays double and gets a gold star.

lockExplainer.line: Fence a ball into a tight pocket to lock it for extra points.

interactiveTutorial.dragInstruction: Drag inside the area to grow a slicing wall. Don't let a ball hit it while it grows!

levelComplete.title: Level Complete!

level.title: Level
level.body: The map you just cleared. Later maps pay a higher base overtime and introduce new ball types and mechanics.
level.tip: Keep your run alive to reach deeper, higher-paying maps. Upgrades bought between levels last the whole run.

remaining.title: Remaining Space
remaining.body: How much of the board was still open when you won. You clear a level by fencing off space until the open area drops below the map's target.
remaining.tip: Clearing more than required feeds the Space Bonus, and meeting the target fast pays the Ship Early bonus.

fencesUsed.title: Fences vs Par
fencesUsed.body: How many fences you used against the map's par. At or under par pays the full base overtime. Each fence over par scales it down (x0.75, x0.6, then x0.4), and 3 or more over par also switches off the Space Bonus.
fencesUsed.tip: Favor fewer, bigger cuts. Finishing even one fence under par adds a bonus hour.

spaceBonus.title: Space Bonus
spaceBonus.body: Extra area removed beyond the map's requirement. The ladder pays +1h at 10% extra, +2h at 30% and +3h at 55%. It is disabled if you finish 3 or more fences over par.
spaceBonus.tip: Before your winning cut, squeeze out a little more of the board. Near-total clears pay the top rung.

baseOvertime.title: Base Overtime
baseOvertime.body: The map's fixed payout, scaled by your fence performance. Every map pays a flat base, so the bonuses on this screen are where the real earnings are.
baseOvertime.tip: Stay at or under par to keep the full base, then stack bonuses on top of it.

threadLocks.title: Thread Locks
threadLocks.body: You lock a ball by sealing it into its own small pocket of the board, cut off from everything else. Each locked ball pays its lock value, and tougher ball types pay more. Trapping several balls with a single cut multiplies the whole payout by the number caught: 2 at once pays double, 3 pays triple. Sealing a ball into an extra tight pocket upgrades it to a Superior Lock, which pays double.
threadLocks.tip: Lock a green money ball early: it triples what every later lock this map pays. Then herd balls close together and close one cut around the whole group.

superiorLocks.title: Superior Locks
superiorLocks.body: A Superior Lock is a lock with real craft: the pocket you sealed the ball into was well under half the size that would normally lock it. Superior locks pay double the lock value, and money-ball, frozen and multi-trap multipliers all stack on top.
superiorLocks.tip: Place your sealing cut as close to the ball as you dare. A roomy, lazy pocket only ever earns standard lock value; the tight cage is where the money is.

zoneLocks.title: Zone Locks
zoneLocks.body: A map's coloured var, let and const boxes pay a multiplier (1.5x, 2x, 3x) on any ball locked inside them. It stacks with everything else, so a tight, Superior lock inside a const box is the biggest single payout in the game. This row shows only the hours the zone added; they are already counted in your lock income above.
zoneLocks.tip: The zone lights up the moment a lock counts. If it stays dark, the pocket you sealed did not land inside the box: aim for the ball to settle within the border, not merely near it.

breakBonus.title: Demolition Bonus
breakBonus.body: Overtime from smashing amber breakable blocks. Balls chip away at a breakable on contact until it shatters, and anything stacked on top falls with it.
breakBonus.tip: Steer balls into breakables with your cuts. The black ball smashes them in half the hits.

shipEarly.title: Ship Early
shipEarly.body: A tempo bonus for meeting the win condition fast: +1h within 60 seconds, +2h within 40, +3h within 25. Only active play counts, menus and the push prompt don't.
shipEarly.tip: Open with big, confident cuts instead of many small safe ones. Speed and precision are separate bonuses, so you can chase both.

pushBonus.title: Push Bonus
pushBonus.body: The push-your-luck reward. After meeting the map's target you can keep cutting instead of banking, and every extra slice of the board pays bonus overtime.
pushBonus.tip: Pushing is free money: if you fail mid-push you only lose the extra bonus, never your banked score.

pickupBonus.title: Power-Up Bonus
pickupBonus.body: Overtime from power-up tokens you sealed in with a lock. A token only pays when a ball locks in the pocket holding it: capture the token's area with no ball and it is wasted, and unclaimed tokens expire on their own.
pickupBonus.tip: Herd a ball toward the token before you seal the pocket. Token overtime is paid after the per-map cap, so it always counts.

overtime.name: Overtime +{{value}}h:
overtime.desc: paid on top of the map's cap.

fork.name: Ball split:
fork.desc: split a ball into more lock income.

freeShopItem.name: Free store item:
freeShopItem.desc: the cheapest offer in your next open store is free.

rainbowConvert.name: Rainbow ball:
rainbowConvert.desc: turned a ball into a high-value rainbow ball.

overtimePercent.name: Overtime +{{value}}%:
overtimePercent.desc: paid a share of your banked overtime, on top of the cap.

newHighscore.title: New Highscore
newHighscore.body: You beat this map's previous record, so the whole payout is multiplied by x1.25. It applies after the per-map cap, so breaking a record always pays extra.
newHighscore.tip: Records are kept per map. A strong upgrade build can beat your old scores map after map.

totalBonus.title: Total Bonus
totalBonus.body: All this level's bonuses added together: par, space, locks, demolition, tempo and push.
totalBonus.tip: Bonuses fold under a per-map cap of twice the base payout, so spreading across several bonus types beats maxing out just one.

overtimeEarned.title: Overtime Earned
overtimeEarned.body: What this level paid in total: the scaled base plus all bonuses, capped at twice the map's base payout. A new highscore multiplies past the cap.
overtimeEarned.tip: If you hit the cap often, chase the highscore multiplier: it is applied after the cap, so it always pays.

totalOvertime.title: Total Overtime
totalOvertime.body: Your whole run's overtime so far. It is the currency you spend in the upgrade shop between levels, and what gets banked when the run ends.
totalOvertime.tip: Spending buys power and charges Budget Cycle boons, while a fat bank feeds Runway perks and War Chest. Your build decides which way to lean.

recordPace.title: Record Pace
recordPace.body: Compares your total overtime right now with your best run at the same point (same number of maps completed). Past your best run's end it compares against its final score.
recordPace.tip: Behind pace? Take more risks: lock greedily and push your luck. Ahead? Protect the lead.

axis_delivery.title: Delivery
axis_delivery.body: The share of the map's balls you actually sealed away. It is the baseline, not a tactic: it ignores how tight the pockets were, and it gates the other three style lanes, so a clear that locks nothing is worth its flat base and no more.
axis_delivery.tip: Lock every ball. A ball left loose costs you its share of Delivery AND the same share of Tempo, Thrift and Greed.

axis_craft.title: Craft
axis_craft.body: How good the locks were, not how many. A full lane is every ball sealed in a superior pocket, and colored areas, two balls in one cut, money balls and frozen locks all reach the same ceiling by other routes.
axis_craft.tip: Tight pockets cost time and fences, so Craft is bought with Tempo and Thrift. Pick one pair and commit.

axis_tempo.title: Tempo
axis_tempo.body: How fast you first met the win condition, in active play seconds. The windows scale with the map's ball count, and pauses and the push prompt do not count.
axis_tempo.tip: Speed is bought by leaving pockets loose. If you want the Craft lane instead, ignore the clock entirely: it is worth about the same.

axis_thrift.title: Thrift
axis_thrift.body: Finishing under par, measured as a fraction of par so a par-4 map and a par-10 map are equally winnable lanes.
axis_thrift.tip: Coarse cuts finish under par but leave loose pockets, so Thrift and Craft pull against each other. Pair Thrift with Tempo.

axis_greed.title: Greed
axis_greed.body: How much of the board you were allowed to leave that you took anyway, plus push-your-luck and demolition hours. Switches off entirely at three fences over par.
axis_greed.tip: Extra clearing costs fences and time. Greed pairs naturally with Craft, and fights Thrift for every cut.

winBonus.title: Win bonus
winBonus.body: Some maps ask for something harder than clearing the board: a ball sealed inside a coloured zone, a tight pocket, a named ball trapped. When a map's win conditions carry a premium, meeting them pays that percent on top of everything the map earned.
winBonus.tip: The premium is set per condition by the map, so it is the same for every route. It scales what you earned, which means playing a hard map well is worth more than scraping through it.

tutorial.achievementsCertificatesBody: Play more to unlock achievements and certificates. Achievements reward lifetime milestones with permanent run bonuses. Certificates are earned by mastering specific upgrades across multiple runs and can be purchased in the Certificate Store for lasting effects.

ballTypes.title: Ball Types
ballTypes.intro: A ball's colour tells you what it does. Which balls appear is decided by the level you've reached - new colours unlock as you climb.
ballTypes.notEncounteredYet: Not encountered yet. Lock it for more info.

swipeToCut.title: Swipe to Cut
swipeToCut.description: Swipe or drag to create a slicing wall. Horizontal or vertical based on your swipe direction.

removeEmptySpace.title: Remove Empty Space
removeEmptySpace.description: When the wall completes, the side WITHOUT the ball is removed and becomes darkness.

avoidTheBall.title: Avoid the Ball
avoidTheBall.description: Don't let the ball hit the wall while it's still growing - instant game over!

winCondition.title: Win Condition
winCondition.description: Reduce the arena below the level's target size to win. Trap a ball in a small enough region and it locks away for a bonus!

breakObstacles.title: Breaking Obstacles
breakObstacles.description: Later levels add amber breakable blocks. Guide balls into them to smash them for bonus overtime - stacked pieces fall when their support breaks. You still win by shrinking the board; breaking is extra. You can't fence against a breakable (it fizzles), and the black ball breaks things in half the hits.

lives.title: Lives
lives.description: You start each run with a set number of lives. Lose a life every time a ball hits your growing fence. Run out of lives and the run ends.

checkpoints.title: Checkpoints
checkpoints.description: Every 5 levels is a checkpoint. When your run ends, your next run always restarts from the highest checkpoint you reached - you never lose all your progress.

headStartCertificates.title: Head Start Certificates
headStartCertificates.description: In the Certificate Store you can unlock Head Start certificates that permanently raise your starting level - so experienced players never have to replay early levels.

welcome.certLockedBody:
Certificates are permanent bonuses you earn by mastering upgrade families across multiple runs.

Reach the top tier of an upgrade family, or unlock your first certificate by playing, and this store opens up.

Then spend Certificate Hours (earned every 5 levels you complete) to level certificates up for lasting effects.
welcome.dailyIntroBody: Every day everyone gets the exact same run from one shared seed: same levels, drafts, shops and obstacles. Your result lands on the daily leaderboard, and playing builds a streak. Starts at level 1.

tierDraft.holdHint: Press and hold a card for details.

certificateEffects.showHighscoreProgress: Adds the map highscore bar to the HUD
certificateEffects.storeLockReliefOne: The store never asks for more than one lock
certificateEffects.storeLockReliefFull: The store never asks for locks at all

boardInfo.hint: Hold anything on the board to see what it is.

pickup.title: Power-up token
pickup.body: Seal this inside a pocket when you lock a ball and you claim it. Capture it without a lock and it is wasted.

chestLoot.title: Loot
chestLoot.body: Dropped by a smashed chest, showing what you won. The reward is already yours, so there is nothing to collect.

dormantBall.title: Sleeping ball
dormantBall.body: Not in play yet, and fences pass straight through it. Route a fence through its terminal to wake it. It cannot be locked while it sleeps.

ball.title: Ball
ball.body: Fence it into a small sealed pocket to lock it. Locks are where the money is; clearing empty space pays very little.

terminal.title: Circuit terminal
terminal.body: Draw a fence through it to light it. Complete the circuit and the ball it is wired to wakes up.

chest.title: Treasure chest
chest.body: Smash it with a ball for loot. Every smash also raises this map payout.

objective.title: Objective crate
objective.body: This map asks you to break it. Send a ball into it.

breakable.title: Breakable block
breakable.body: Takes a few hits before it shatters, and cracks as it weakens. Breaking it reopens the space underneath.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.body: Bounces balls off at hard angles, which makes their path hard to predict. The black ball can smash it.

mover.title: Moving block
mover.body: Slides along its track, so a gap here is only temporary. Time your fence around it.

phasing.title: Phasing block
phasing.body: Fades in and out on a cycle. Solid when visible, passable when not. A fence drawn through it while it is out will be cut when it returns.

obstacle.title: Obstacle
obstacle.body: Solid. Balls bounce off it and fences stop dead against it, which makes it a good anchor for a pocket.

area.title: Marked zone
area.body: Lock a ball with this zone captured and it pays a multiplier. On some maps it is the only way to win.

gameMessages.breakableAnchor: A fence cannot anchor on something breakable. Smash it out of the way first, or run your cut to solid wall.
gameMessages.fenceLimit: You are already growing as many fences as you can at once. Wait for one to finish, or upgrade to grow more.
gameMessages.capturedStart: Start your fence in open space. That ground has already been captured.
gameMessages.wallInTheWay: A fence is already anchored there. Start from open space a little further along.
